Speakers, World AI Summit 2026

The speaker line-up for World AI Summit 2026 (14-15 October 2026, Sheraton Grand Bangalore Hotel at Brigade Gateway, Bengaluru, India) is being announced. Below are the 28 government, enterprise and founder speakers who addressed the first edition in 2025. Confirmed 2026 speakers are marked as they are added.
